batchRequirements.title: Consumer credit and property cash flows
batchRequirements.requiredCompetencies: Consumer/property finance professional with lending, lease and real-estate cash-flow expertise; numerical competence for amortization/inversion. Lease tax requires jurisdiction-qualified tax co-review.
batchRequirements.sharedReview: Shared dated cash-flow/fees/rounding conventions first; then case-specific lending, lease and property boundaries.

batchRequirements.title: Retirement projections and quantitative business models
batchRequirements.requiredCompetencies: Qualified quantitative financial model reviewer competent in withdrawal/sequence risk, discounted cohort cash flows, root/depletion behavior and numerical validation; retirement advice competence for retirement claims.
batchRequirements.sharedReview: Review shared accumulation/withdrawal and discount conventions once. #87 safe withdrawal study and #173 LTV require separate model/dataset applicability decisions.

batchRequirements.title: Jurisdictional tax, payroll and pension rules
batchRequirements.requiredCompetencies: Qualified tax/payroll/pension practitioner for EACH selected jurisdiction and tax year; employment-law competence for overtime; numerical reviewer for inverses/marginal discontinuities. A single credential is not presumed to cover all jurisdictions or employment law.
batchRequirements.sharedReview: Select jurisdictions, tax years and plan types before commissioning rule review. Reuse one approved rule pack across forward/inverse/effective/marginal cases.

batchRequirements.title: Provider fees and returns accounting
batchRequirements.requiredCompetencies: Accountant/commerce finance reviewer experienced with marketplace settlement, refunds, inventory recovery and the selected seller jurisdiction; tax co-review where applicable.
batchRequirements.sharedReview: Review one dated fee schedule and recognition policy; apply to the two provider calculators and separate returns accounting.

batchRequirements.title: Exercise heart-rate and VO2 protocols
batchRequirements.requiredCompetencies: Clinical exercise physiologist or sports-medicine clinician with protocol validation and population/screening competence; numerical validation of the chosen predictive equation.
batchRequirements.sharedReview: Settle #404 first, reuse approved heart-rate basis for #526; #530 remains a separately selected/validated protocol.

batchRequirements.title: Obstetric dating and pregnancy guidance
batchRequirements.requiredCompetencies: Qualified obstetric clinician with pregnancy dating, weight-gain guidance, fertility uncertainty and population applicability expertise.
batchRequirements.sharedReview: Shared calendar/dating basis first; separate weight-gain and ovulation/conception uncertainty decisions.

batchRequirements.title: Renal filtration estimation
batchRequirements.requiredCompetencies: Nephrologist or appropriately qualified renal clinician/laboratory medicine specialist competent in current eGFR equations, assay units and population restrictions.
batchRequirements.sharedReview: One equation/version/assay/population selection; independent vectors and interpretive limits.

batchRequirements.title: Sleep guidance
batchRequirements.requiredCompetencies: Sleep-medicine clinician or appropriately qualified sleep-health researcher with age-specific guideline applicability.
batchRequirements.sharedReview: Distinguish scheduling arithmetic from clinical sleep recommendations.

batchRequirements.title: Greenhouse-gas accounting
batchRequirements.requiredCompetencies: GHG inventory practitioner competent in boundaries, scopes, activity-factor matching, CO2e/GWP versions and dataset licensing.
batchRequirements.sharedReview: Freeze one jurisdiction/year factor dataset and prevent double counting.

batchRequirements.title: Heat-pump energy analysis
batchRequirements.requiredCompetencies: HVAC/building-energy engineer competent in seasonal performance, heat demand, auxiliary energy and tariff boundaries.
batchRequirements.sharedReview: Approve annual heat/seasonal COP boundary before cost comparisons.

batchRequirements.title: Food thermal safety
batchRequirements.requiredCompetencies: Food process/thermal engineer with food-safety validation competence; food-safety specialist co-review if not held by the same person.
batchRequirements.sharedReview: Do not derive safe cooking time from simple weight/temperature scaling; require validated food/geometry/appliance endpoint evidence.

batchRequirements.title: Institutional grading
batchRequirements.requiredCompetencies: Registrar/academic policy specialist authorized or competent to interpret the selected institution/year grading and repeat-course policies.
batchRequirements.sharedReview: Select institution and academic year; weighted arithmetic alone does not establish policy.

batchRequirements.title: Race performance prediction
batchRequirements.requiredCompetencies: Sports performance scientist/exercise physiologist competent in empirical race-prediction calibration, validation and uncertainty.
batchRequirements.sharedReview: Select model/exponent/calibration population and supported distances.

batchRequirements.title: Golf handicap governance
batchRequirements.requiredCompetencies: Qualified current WHS/selected-system handicap official or specialist familiar with regional implementation and eligible-score adjustments.
batchRequirements.sharedReview: Use governing revision and published examples, not a simplified handicap approximation.
